Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ الَّذِيْ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
Translation: O Allah, from whom nothing is hidden

Arabic text: شَيْءٌ فِيْ الْأَرْضِ وَ لَا فِيْ السَّمَاءِ
Translation: Anything on the earth or in the heavens

Arabic text: وَ كَيْفَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ
Translation: And how could anything be hidden from You, O my God, when You created it

Arabic text: وَ كَيْفَ لَا تُحْصِيْ مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ
Translation: And how could You not account for what You have made

Arabic text: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ
Translation: Or how could anything be absent from You when You are managing it

Arabic text: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لَا حَيَاةَ لَهُ إِلَّا بِرِزْقِكَ
Translation: Or how could one escape from You when he has no life except through Your sustenance

Arabic text: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُوْ مِنْكَ مَنْ لَا مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِيْ غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ
Translation: Or how could one be saved from You when he has no refuge outside Your dominion

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ أَخْشَى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ
Translation: Glory be to You, the most fearful of You among Your creation are those who know You best

Arabic text: وَ أَخْضَعُهُمْ لَكَ أَعْمَلُهُمْ بِطَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And the most submissive to You are those who act most in Your obedience

Arabic text: وَ أَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَ هُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ
Translation: And the most insignificant to You is the one whom You provide for while he worships other than You

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا يَنْقُصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَ كَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You, Your authority is not diminished by those who associate partners with You and deny Your messengers

Arabic text: وَ لَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَاءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ
Translation: And he who dislikes Your decree cannot repel Your command

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
Translation: And he who denies Your power cannot escape from You

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَفُوتُكَ مَنْ عَبَدَ غَيْرَكَ
Translation: And he who worships other than You cannot elude You

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُعَمَّرُ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَكَ
Translation: And he who dislikes meeting You will not live forever in this world

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَ أَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You, how great is Your glory, how dominating is Your authority

Arabic text: وَ أَشَدَّ قُوَّتَكَ، وَ أَنْفَذَ أَمْرَكَ
Translation: How intense is Your power, and how effective is Your command

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ
Translation: Glory be to You, You have decreed death upon all Your creation

Arabic text: مَنْ وَحَّدَكَ وَ مَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ
Translation: Those who affirm Your Oneness and those who disbelieve in You

Arabic text: وَ كُلٌّ ذَائِقُ الْمَوْتِ
Translation: And everyone shall taste death

Arabic text: وَ كُلٌّ صَائِرٌ إِلَيْكَ، فَتَبَارَكْتَ وَ تَعَالَيْتَ
Translation: And everyone shall return to You, blessed and exalted are You

Arabic text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ
Translation: There is no god but You alone, with no partner, I believe in You

Arabic text: وَ صَدَّقْتُ رُسُلَكَ وَ قَبِلْتُ كِتَابَكَ
Translation: And I affirm Your messengers and accept Your Book

Arabic text: وَ كَفَرْتُ بِكُلِّ مَعْبُودٍ غَيْرِكَ
Translation: And I reject every deity other than You

Arabic text: وَ بَرِئْتُ مِمَّنْ عَبَدَ سِوَاكَ
Translation: And I disassociate myself from those who worship other than You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أُصْبِحُ وَ أُمْسِيْ مُسْتَقِلًّا لِعَمَلِي
Translation: O Allah, I begin my morning and evening considering my deeds as insufficient

Arabic text: مُعْتَرِفًا بِذَنْبِيْ، مُقِرًّا بِخَطَايَايَ
Translation: Acknowledging my sins, confessing my mistakes

Arabic text: أَنَا بِإِسْرَاْفِيْ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ ذَلِيلٌ
Translation: I am humiliated by my excesses against myself

Arabic text: عَمَلِيْ أَهْلَكَنِيْ، وَ هَوَايَ أَرْدَانِي
Translation: My actions have destroyed me, and my desires have ruined me

Arabic text: وَ شَهَوَاتِيْ حَرَمَتْنِي
Translation: And my passions have deprived me

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ سُؤَالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لَاهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ
Translation: So I ask You, O my Master, like one whose soul is distracted by lengthy hopes

Arabic text: وَ بَدَنُهُ غَافِلٌ لِسُكُونِ عُرُوقِهِ
Translation: And whose body is heedless due to the stillness of his veins

Arabic text: وَ قَلْبُهُ مَفْتُونٌ بِكَثْرَةِ النِّعَمِ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And whose heart is captivated by the abundance of blessings upon him

Arabic text: وَ فِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And whose thoughts are few about what he is heading towards

Arabic text: سُؤَالَ مَنْ قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْأَمَلُ
Translation: The request of one who is overcome by hope

Arabic text: وَ فَتَنَهُ الْهَوَى، وَ اسْتَمْكَنَتْ مِنْهُ الدُّنْيَا
Translation: And tempted by desire, and engrossed in this world

Arabic text: وَ أَظَلَّهُ الْأَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ
Translation: And overshadowed by death, the request of one who acknowledges his abundant sins

Arabic text: وَ اعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لَا رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ
Translation: And confesses his mistakes, the request of one who has no Lord but You

Arabic text: وَ لَا وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَ لَا مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ
Translation: And no guardian besides You, and no savior from You

Arabic text: وَ لَا مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And no refuge from You except in You

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْوَاجِبِ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: My God, I ask You by Your right that is obligatory upon all Your creation

Arabic text: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الَّذِيْ أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ
Translation: And by Your Great Name which You commanded Your Messenger to glorify You with

Arabic text: وَ بِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَبْلَى
Translation: And by the majesty of Your Noble Face which does not decay

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَ لَا يَحُولُ وَ لَا يَفْنَى
Translation: And does not change, and does not alter, and does not perish

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ تُغْنِيَنِيْ عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ بِعِبَادَتِكَ
Translation: And that You make me content with Your worship over everything else

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ
Translation: And that You comfort my soul from this world through fear of You

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ تُثْنِيَنِيْ بِالْكَثِيرِ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And that You reward me with abundant honors by Your mercy

Arabic text: فَإِلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَ بِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
Translation: For to You I flee, and You I fear, and You I seek for help

Arabic text: وَ إِيَّاكَ أَرْجُوْ، وَ لَكَ أَدْعُوْ، وَ إِلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ
Translation: And in You I hope, and to You I pray, and to You I seek refuge

Arabic text: وَ بِكَ أَثِقُ، وَ إِيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَ بِكَ أُومِنُ
Translation: And in You I trust, and You I seek for assistance, and in You I believe

Arabic text: وَ عَلَيْكَ أَتَوَكَّلُ
Translation: And upon You I rely

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى جُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ أَتَّكِلُ
Translation: And on Your generosity and nobility I depend
